rows.proof_or_counterproof_body: Binary whole-document labels induce constant release decisions across all document parts. PUBLIC releases both public text and private data, violating withholding of private data. PRIVATE withholds both, violating disclosure of public text. No binary label remains. A part-level release/redaction classifier assigns release(public_text)=true and release(private_data)=false, satisfying both constraints.
rows.falsifier_check: Falsified only by a binary whole-document label whose semantics release one part and withhold the other; that is not a public/private whole-document binary classifier.
rows.dependency_closure: Closed by exhaustive case split over PUBLIC and PRIVATE plus the defined obligation vector.
rows.independent_verification: Executable Python artifact asserts no binary solutions, exactly one enriched solution, and countermodel availability for the overbroad universal reading.

rows.proof_or_counterproof_body: In an archive that already has release/redact/restrict/review categories, the mixed document is processed by an existing redaction operator. The event does not create a new axis and does not collapse the archive. Therefore the claim that every contradiction as such necessarily births a dimension or collapses is false.
rows.falsifier_check: The counterproof fails only after narrowing the claim to unresolved contradictions under descriptions without adequate existing repair; that narrowed schema is OC25-CP-SCHEMA-001, not the refuted universal reading.
rows.dependency_closure: Depends on the same mixed-obligation model plus an existing enriched classifier; no outside empirical assumption is used.
rows.independent_verification: Executable Python artifact checks that the enriched classifier satisfies the obligations, giving the existing-repair countermodel.

rows.proof_or_counterproof_body: Assume no same-description repair satisfies the active constraints. By excluded middle over the extension repair class, either some extension repair satisfies the constraints or none does. If one does, the dimension-extension route exists. If none does and organization requires successful constraint satisfaction, organization fails under the active task. These cases exhaust the bounded model.
rows.falsifier_check: Falsified only by a task satisfying the trigger where no same-description repair exists, no extension repair exists, successful satisfaction is required, and organization nevertheless does not fail; this contradicts the explicit organization predicate. Existing-repair cases fail the trigger.
rows.dependency_closure: Depends on OC25-LOCAL-ARCHIVE-001, OC25-CP-UNIVERSAL-001, and explicit repair/organization definitions in the artifact.
rows.independent_verification: Executable artifact checks extension, collapse, and existing-repair cases.

rows.proof_or_counterproof_body: The dependency graph defines constraints, repairs, descriptions, repair classes, and organization predicates before the central schema. Contradiction trigger depends on constraints and same-description repair class; dimension extension route depends on constraints and extension repair class; collapse route depends on constraints, extension repairs, and organization predicate. Only the bounded central schema depends on these route definitions, so the definitions are non-circular for the bounded theory.
rows.falsifier_check: Falsified by a dependency cycle, missing required primitive, or a primitive definition depending on bounded_central_schema. The executable audit checks and rejects these possibilities.
rows.dependency_closure: Closed for the bounded formal schema only; cross-domain primitive adequacy remains outside this theorem.
rows.independent_verification: Executable audit reports acyclic graph, no primitive dependency on central schema, and all required terms available.

rows.proof_or_counterproof_body: A finite OC state model represents the six source operators as finite input-output transitions. A single parameterized rewrite(source,target) operator reproduces each transition by choosing the corresponding target state. Thus the six-operator catalogue is not globally minimal or unique as a basis for finite transitions.
rows.falsifier_check: Falsified if rewrite cannot reproduce one of the six witness transitions; the executable artifact checks all six.
rows.dependency_closure: Closed against the strong minimality/uniqueness claim only. Semantic usefulness of the names remains a separate non-minimality claim.
rows.independent_verification: Executable countermodel reports successful simulation of Birth, Differentiate, Stabilize, Project, Kill, and Repair witness transitions.

rows.proof_or_counterproof_body: Under the typed-invariant rule, both a source-style chain and an alternative chain are strict monotone invariant extensions and reach the same endpoint, but the alternative splits a multi-invariant level into two levels and therefore has a different count. Thus the invariant rule does not force the K0-K12 count as unique, exhaustive, or minimal.
rows.falsifier_check: Falsified if the alternative chain is not strict monotone, does not share the endpoint, or has the same length; the executable artifact checks these properties.
rows.dependency_closure: Closed against the strong count/uniqueness claim only; local adjacent distinctness remains possible under explicit invariant witnesses.
rows.independent_verification: Executable countermodel reports strict monotone source and alternative chains, same endpoint, and different counts.

rows.proof_or_counterproof_body: A mixed archive obligation exists in a system that already has redaction/review structure. Existing repair satisfies the obligation without event-level new axis and without archive collapse. Therefore unconditional law-like promotion of contradiction -> dimension/collapse is false without trigger and scope conditions.
rows.falsifier_check: Falsified if existing repair fails, or if dimension birth/collapse still necessarily occurs; executable artifact checks that repair succeeds and unconditional law output is false.
rows.dependency_closure: Closed against unconditional law promotion; bounded theorem/schema claims remain separate and already closed in OC25-CP-SCHEMA-001.
rows.independent_verification: Executable countermodel prints PASS and asserts mixed obligation, existing repair, no dimension birth, no collapse, and false unconditional law claim.

rows.proof_or_counterproof_body: Established crown-stone consequence wording requires the relevant strong OC dependencies. 025 refutes global operator minimality, unique/exhaustive K0-K12 count, and unconditional law wording. Therefore crown-stone claims depending on the full strong model are not established consequences.
rows.falsifier_check: Falsified if no required dependency had failed; executable artifact lists failed dependencies and asserts the established-consequence predicate is false.
rows.dependency_closure: Depends on terminal counterproofs OC25-OPERATORS-001, OC25-KLEVEL-001, and OC25-LAWS-001.
rows.independent_verification: Executable artifact reports failed dependencies and PASS for the counterproof.

rows.proof_or_counterproof_body: Two cases share the same abstract OC signature no_same_repair_then_extension. One has local observables, falsifier, and empirical support; the other lacks them. The core signature alone would validate both, but local validation differs. Therefore the OC core theorem chain alone does not validate domain projections.
rows.falsifier_check: Falsified if same abstract OC signature forced same local validation status; executable artifact checks same signature with different validation statuses.
rows.dependency_closure: Closed against core-only validation wording. Locally evidenced projections remain separate proof/evidence targets.
rows.independent_verification: Executable countermodel reports same signature and different validation status.
